methods.method_description: Initialize the Printers flow with driver and optional previous flow

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Reference to the previous flow in the navigation chain

methods.method_purpose: Initializes the Printers flow by calling parent SmartFlow constructor and setting up the driver and previous flow reference

methods.method_description: Select a printer from the available printers list

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the printer to select from the list
Flag to determine whether to raise exception on failure

methods.method_purpose: Navigates to printers list, searches for the specified printer by name, and selects it. Returns True on success, False on failure if raise_e is False

methods.method_description: Verify that the expected printer name is displayed

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Flag to determine whether to raise exception on verification failure

methods.method_purpose: Checks if the specified printer name is visible on the screen. Returns True if found, False otherwise (if raise_e is False)

methods.method_description: Retrieve the currently displayed printer name
methods.method_purpose: Extracts and returns the printer name text from the UI element
Clicks on the 'Add Printer' button to initiate the printer addition flow

methods.method_description: Verify that the add printer screen is displayed

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the screen to appear

methods.method_purpose: Checks if the add printer screen elements are visible within the specified timeout period

methods.method_description: Search for a printer using the search functionality

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Printer name or identifier to search for

methods.method_purpose: Enters the printer name into the search field to filter available printers

methods.method_description: Verify that the searched printer appears in results

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Printer name to verify in search results
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the printer to appear

methods.method_purpose: Validates that the specified printer appears in the search results within the timeout period

methods.method_description: Click on a printer from the search results

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the printer to click from search results

methods.method_purpose: Selects and clicks on the specified printer from the search results list

methods.method_description: Remove a printer from the saved printers list

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the printer to remove

methods.method_purpose: Navigates to printer settings and removes the specified printer from the saved list

methods.method_description: Verify that a printer has been successfully removed

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Name of the printer that should no longer be present
Maximum time in seconds to wait for verification

methods.method_purpose: Confirms that the specified printer is no longer visible in the printers list
